description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 28 of 2007 - Order under section 5 (Reserved)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a regulatory order made under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It modifies the levy amount on imported maize for animal feed production, which constitutes a regulatory change to existing legislation. While it mentions Prof. G. L. Peiris as the Acting Minister of Finance, this is incidental to the regulatory function being performed. The core content is about modifying a legal/regulatory framework (tax/levy structure) rather than being primarily about government personnel or organizational structure, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
